card.title: The Same Ending
card.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 predicts a sequence ending in returned keys; A3 exhaustion means A is a burden and A5 a restaurant means controlled breakup.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 gives tiredness as the cancellation reason; A3 matches it to an ex; B4 tomorrow's table becomes A5 public rejection.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects A's overstatement and B4 actively reschedules, showing credible willingness to meet.

heightening.evidence: B4 restores the date; A5 deepens the feared ending into where A will be unable to beg.

specificity.evidence: A1 cancelled lunch and key, B4 usual table, and A5 corner establish a recognisable intimate dispute.
